user_query: vertical AI applications like Harvey for legal

criteria.rationale: Distinguishes companies building AI models or apps that generate text/answers from vendors that only provide non-generative tools or services.

criteria.text: Focuses on the legal industry or legal professionals
criteria.rationale: Ensures peers serve the same domain (law firms, in-house legal teams, lawyers) rather than other professional domains.

criteria.text: Provides a domain-specific (vertical) AI product tailored to legal use cases
criteria.rationale: Separates vertical legal AI applications from general-purpose or horizontal AI platforms that require heavy customization.

criteria.text: Offers an application that augments legal professional services workflows
criteria.rationale: Identifies companies that deliver practical workflow improvements (e.g., drafting, research, contract review) rather than research prototypes or infrastructure components.

criteria.text: Targets law firms or corporate legal departments as customers
criteria.rationale: Differentiates vendors selling to legal practitioners from consumer-facing or unrelated enterprise markets.

criteria.text: Delivers AI functionality through a productized application or SaaS integrated into legal workflows
criteria.rationale: Distinguishes product-first legal AI companies from companies that only offer models, APIs, or consulting without an integrated legal application.
